unlock.title: Unlock your vault
unlock.hint: Unlocking takes about a second while your password is checked.
unlock.recoveryHint: Type or paste the 24 words, separated by spaces.
unlock.footer: Nothing is decrypted to this computer's disk. Pulling the stick locks the vault.
unlock.tooNewTitle: Update Cinasafe to open this vault
unlock.tooNewBody: This vault was made by a newer version of Cinasafe. Use the player app on the stick, or update this copy.
unlock.restoredFromBackup: The library file was damaged, so its backup copy was opened. Recent changes may be missing.
unlock.lockedIdle: Locked after a period of inactivity.
unlock.lockedRemoved: The stick was removed, so the vault was locked.
unlock.lockedSleep: Locked because the computer went to sleep.

home.emptyTitle: Add your first movie or show
home.emptyBody: Drop video files or whole folders in, and Cinasafe encrypts them onto this stick. Your originals stay where they are.

detail.exportWarning: The exported copy is not encrypted.
detail.notFound: This item is no longer in the vault.

remove.body: “{{title}}” and its subtitles and artwork are deleted from the stick. This can't be undone. Your original files elsewhere are not affected.

player.fixRtlHint: Moves punctuation that shows up at the wrong end of Hebrew or Arabic lines.
player.slowStick: This stick may be too slow for this file. Playback could pause to buffer.

search.title: Search
search.label: Search the vault
search.prompt: Type to search everything on this stick.

add.title: Add media
add.dropTitle: Drop movies, episodes, subtitles or whole folders here
add.dropBody: Files are encrypted as they're copied. Your originals stay where they are.
add.lookupOnline: Look up posters and details online (TMDB)
add.lookupOnlineHint: File names are sent to the metadata service. Nothing else leaves this computer.

state.wontFit: Not enough space on the stick
state.noVideo: No video to attach this subtitle to

review.title: Review match
review.lookupsOff: Online lookup is off. Turn it on in Settings › Security › Privacy to search, or enter the details yourself.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hwdecHint: Uses the graphics card to decode video. Turn off if you see glitches.
settings.languageOrderHint: In order of preference. Applied when a file opens.
settings.subtitlePreview: Subtitles look like this · כתוביות נראות כך
settings.passwordBody: Changing the password doesn't re-encrypt your media. It takes a second.
settings.recoveryNone: This vault has no recovery key.
settings.replaceRecoveryBody: A new key replaces the old one, which stops working. Enter your password to continue.
settings.lockOnRemoval: Lock when the stick is removed
settings.lookupOnlineBody: When on, Cinasafe sends the titles it reads from file names to TMDB (or TVmaze for shows) to fetch posters and descriptions. Nothing else leaves this computer, and nothing is stored outside the stick.
settings.tmdbKeyHint: Needed for movie details. Without one, only shows are looked up (TVmaze).
settings.integrityBody: Decrypts every file on the stick to check nothing is damaged or missing. Takes a while on a big vault.
settings.playerAppsBody: Copies this version of Cinasafe onto the stick so it runs on Windows and Linux computers without installing anything.
settings.licensesBody: Cinasafe is free software under the Apache License 2.0. It uses mpv, FFmpeg, libass, HarfBuzz, FriBidi and the Rubik and Noto fonts, under their own licences.
settings.tmdbAttribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Show details may also come from TVmaze.

wizard.title: Create a Cinasafe vault
wizard.driveBody: The vault lives on the stick, together with the apps that open it.
wizard.noDrives: No removable drives found. Plug in a USB stick and refresh.
wizard.useAsIsBody: Adds a hidden vault folder and the player apps. Existing files stay. No admin rights needed.
wizard.formatBody: Deletes everything on the stick. Your computer will ask for administrator permission.
wizard.formatOnly: This stick uses {{fs}}, which can't hold files over 4 GB or isn't readable everywhere. It has to be formatted to exFAT first.
wizard.passwordBody: You'll type it every time you open the vault.
wizard.noForgot: There's no “forgot password”. If you lose both this password and your recovery key, nobody can open this vault.
wizard.recoveryBody: These 24 words open the vault if you forget the password. They are shown only now. Write them down or print them, and keep them somewhere safe, away from the stick.
wizard.skipBody: If you forget the password, nothing can open this vault. You can create a recovery key later in Settings.
wizard.finishBody: Add movies and shows now, or eject the stick and use it on another computer.
wizard.ejected: You can unplug the stick now.

errors.wrongRecoveryKey: That recovery key doesn't open this vault.
errors.badRecoveryWords: Those aren't 24 valid recovery words. Check the spelling.
errors.noRecoveryKey: This vault has no recovery key.
errors.vaultTooNew: This vault was made by a newer Cinasafe. Update Cinasafe to open it.
errors.vaultExists: This stick already has a vault.
errors.notFound: That item isn't in the vault any more.
errors.verifyFailed: Checking the written file failed. The stick may be faulty.
errors.unauthorized: The metadata service rejected the API key.
errors.playerUnavailable: The player engine (libmpv) isn't available on this computer.
errors.io: The stick couldn't be read or written.
errors.notPortable: This copy of Cinasafe is installed on the computer, not portable. To put the player on the stick, start the AppImage or the Windows app instead.
